set.body:
Stage 3 of the post-closeout NumPy performance plan.

Create a benchmark-only, nonpublished Vector API spike rather than adding jdk.incubator.vector to ravel-core. Target cases where SIMD preserves exact semantics by operating across independent fibers or columns, especially axis-0 reduction, plus comparison/predicate kernels shown slow by Stage 1. Do not use horizontal vector reduction for the default sum schedule. Treat already auto-vectorized contiguous add and transcendental operators as measured controls, not assumed wins.

Run on JDK 21 and JDK 25, AArch64 and x86-64 when runners are available, with scalar fallback controls and correctness receipts. Done means the evidence identifies per-kernel wins/regressions, module and packaging costs, and a go/no-go threshold for any optional JVM artifact. No direct Vector API dependency may enter core under this bead.
set.title: Run a nonpublished targeted JVM Vector API spike
